messages:
mia: Quick interlock for Q3 Private GA — putting together a dependency map + critical path. Need owners for each lane. TL;DR: we have infra capacity, runtime changes, security (KMS/certs), docs, sales enablement, and rollout gating on QA.

arjun: infra: we can reserve 4 pools but need eviction policy defined. Owner: @arjun. Blocker: network egress for customer VPCs.

dana: runtime: KV-cache change and quantized model path must land. Owner: @dana. ETA: +3 weeks after infra capacity is stable.

samir: security: KMS integration + audit log schema. Owner: @samir. Need HSM cert fingerprint from compliance.

ashley: docs & onboarding: need example manifests + upgrade notes. Owner: @ashley. Can start once runtime API is finalized.

leo: qa/load: plan for 1000rps soak and failover tests. Owner: @leo. Also need test data for privacy checks.

product-bot: Checklist created: https://board.company/PRIVATE-GA-checklist — added items and owners.

mia: Proposed critical path (minimal):
```
1) Infra network & reserved pools (owner: arjun) — must clear VPC egress & capacity
2) Runtime kv-cache + quantization merge (owner: dana) — depends on (1)
3) KMS integration + audit (owner: samir) — can run in parallel with (2) but final certs after compliance sign-off
4) QA soak + failover (owner: leo) — depends on (2) and (3)
5) Docs + sales enablement (owner: ashley) — final when API surface is stable
6) Rollout gating & canary (product ops) — post-successful QA
```

mia: Can each owner confirm ETA and major risks by EOD tomorrow? If anyone needs sequence changes (e.g., KMS before runtime), flag now. @arjun @dana @samir @leo @ashley

arjun: Confirmed. ETA for network config: 2w. Risk: cloud provider quota delays.

dana: Runtime ETA: 3w after infra config. Risk: kernel regression with quant path.

samir: KMS ETA: 2w to prototype, 1w for compliance review. Risk: customer HSM onboarding time.

leo: QA ETA: test harness ready in 2w, soak 1w. Need traffic generator creds.

ashley: Docs ETA: draft in 2w, final after API freeze. Will start with onboarding snippets.

mia: Great. I'll collate into the interlock board and surface any cross-team blockers. Next sync Tue 10am. If no blockers, we aim for soft-gate review on {1972507800}.

arjun: adding note — we should define fallback model variant for private in case quant path fails. small design note.

dana: ++ will add fallback and flag memory delta.

samir: I'll add required audit fields to the schema and share sample logs.

product-bot: Reminder: schedule created -> Tue 10:00 interlock meeting invite sent to participants.

mia: Thanks all. If anything pops up ping #eng-oncall or tag me directly.

ashley: :thumbsup:

leo: adding test plan link: https://internal/tests/private-ga

mia: closing the loop here — tracking in the board. Will update tickets and owners. Thanks!
